purpose: Define the primary dyadic comparative-phylogeographic test before formal Palearctic eligibility, LGM predictor construction, or subgroup genetic-response extraction.
scientific_question: Among geographically supported Palearctic Lepidoptera source-target pairs, does similarity in LGM-to-present refugial-persistence geography predict how well the source species' post-IBD spatial genetic turnover transfers to the target species?
historical_caveat: The aggregate 211-species Phase-4 response was previously opened. Species-level subgroup transfer responses are not consulted in defining this protocol; this is a response-blindly redesigned subgroup re-analysis, not a pristine prospective confirmatory dataset.

panel.split: new eligibility-contract-hash 50/50 split; do not inherit the global 103/108 Phase-4 split

pair_support.definition: fraction of target frozen graph-edge midpoints whose nearest source frozen graph-edge midpoint is within 500 km
pair_support.unsupported_pairs: excluded before any subgroup genetic response is computed
pair_support.unsupported_targets: excluded only if fewer than five response-blind supported training sources exist; this is geometry eligibility, not a genetic outcome filter

response.name: T_st
response.definition: Spearman correlation between a source-only TTF field prediction and target endpoint-safe post-IBD edge turnover
response.response_rule_lineage: same source-only dyadic response already frozen for the relational host-resource TTF
response.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected canonical A/C/G/T p-distance under the already frozen 50% comparable-column rule
response.source_training_response: post-IBD turnover rank orthogonalized against source edge-length rank
response.recomputation_note: If subgroup T_st is authorized, the already frozen p-distance/IBD response may be deterministically recomputed from the exact source archive because edge-level vectors were not serialized; no response definition or sequence-selection rule may change.

controls.z_R_current: Schoener D between current climatic-suitability surfaces from the same fitted climatic model
controls.z_geographic_coverage: continuous frozen directed graph-edge geographic coverage
controls.z_current_occurrence_coopportunity: continuous current occurrence geographic co-opportunity from the same filtered response-blind occurrence layer
controls.same_family_indicator: include if nonconstant on the frozen supported dyad set; otherwise record deterministic zero-variance omission

primary_estimand.conceptual_model: T_st = alpha_t + gamma_s + beta_R*z(R_refugia_st) + beta_C*z(R_current_st) + beta_G*z(graph_coverage_st) + beta_D*z(log1p(centroid_distance_km_st)) + beta_O*z(current_occurrence_coopportunity_st) + beta_M*z(abs_log_locality_count_ratio_st) + beta_F*same_family_st + epsilon_st
primary_estimand.covariance: two-way source/target cluster-robust sandwich with dyad intersection subtraction and finite-cluster corrections

predictor_information: unique R_refugia information after all frozen controls
ttf_q_pre_response_qualification.private_structure: source-specific slope on graph coverage and target-specific slope on centroid distance; each random-slope SD = 0.12*A
ttf_q_pre_response_qualification.mde_rule: evaluable grid MDE is reported only for amplitudes whose beta_R=0 Wilson 95% upper rejection bound is <=0.10
ttf_q_pre_response_qualification.opening_detectability_requirement: A0, A1 and A2 must be null-qualified and A2 evaluable grid MDE must be <=0.10; A3 is reported as stress sensitivity but does not independently veto opening if A0-A2 pass
ttf_q_pre_response_qualification.numerical_requirement: finite fits and response-blind predictor condition number < 1e4

opening_rule.required: all eligibility, predictor-information, null-qualification, A2 detectability and numerical requirements pass before subgroup T_st is extracted
